pr_title: rpc: correctly check for nil before cast
pr_body:
As part of the fix of #99104, a cast without a nil check was introduced. This PR addresses that by only casting if it is known to be not nil.

Epic: none
Fixes: #100275
Release note: None
pr_comments:
